statement: Exact derandomization of logarithmic space: $`\mathsf L=\mathsf{RL}=\mathsf{BPL}`$. Proves $`\mathsf L=\mathsf{RL}=\mathsf{BPL}`$, resolving derandomization for bounded-error logarithmic-space computation. An effective compiler converts each randomized polynomial-time logarithmic-space machine deciding a language with one-sided or two-sided error into a deterministic logarithmic-space decider with explicit polynomial running-time bounds.
